title: FOMC Meeting Minutes just Dropped: HAWKISH Updates!
speaker: A1 Trading hosts (Nick and Chris)

macro_themes.view: Minutes read as uniformly hawkish: all 19 backed the September hike, most see another 2026 hike, inflation risks tilted up.
Market prices ~75bp more hikes by mid-2027; this is why yields rise and gold falls.
A 10-20% correction would eventually force the Fed into QE / bond purchases as a backstop, possibly in 2027.
AAII-style sentiment still very bearish, which makes them cautious about calling a top; possible run against shorts.
